stated_parameters.magnification_basis: designed for a ten-power telescope, focal length 2.54 cm and an exit pupil of 5 mm (MIL-HDBK-141 14.2.1)
stated_parameters.back_focus_basis: The table's last spacing is the printed distance from the final surface to the image plane, which is the back focal distance from that vertex; it is negative where the focus falls inside the last surface.

sections.aperture_basis: The source states no clear semi-diameters. Each element is given one clear diameter: the largest of the paraxial marginal-ray and chief-ray envelopes over its own surfaces (marginal ray through the 5 mm exit pupil, chief ray at the stated half field), times a 2 per cent mechanical margin. The envelope is a minimum clear aperture, so every surface of the element passes the axial beam and the chief ray at the full stated field. It is a buildable estimate, not a drawing: no vignetting beyond the stop is modelled and no vignetting figure is claimed.
sections.transcription_notes: Overall imagery better than the orthoscopic; well corrected for lateral colour; eye relief about 20 mm. The source states use out as far as 25 deg; the aberration figures are plotted at 0, 14 and 20 deg.
